title: The Thousand-Handed Devil

sourceEvidence.locator: the victim may be unmistakable while the persecutor disappears
sourceEvidence.excerpt: the victim may be unmistakable while the persecutor disappears into a chain of roles, rules, databases, contractors, incentives, and automated decisions. A patient loses treatment, a worker loses employment, or a family loses assistance, yet each participant can truthfully say that only one limited part of the process belonged to them. The book exists to close the dangerous gap between operational power and inherited ideas of responsibility. It neither personifies complexity as an evil intellige

hook: A patient loses treatment, yet everyone involved can explain why they followed the rules.
readerPromise: Readers encounter a difficult choice between comforting blame and the work of tracing consequences. Where should responsibility live when power is spread across a thousand ordinary actions?
protectedRevelations: Constitution of limits, future-scenario verdicts and institutional recommendations
